unitTitle: Future Simple - Be going to - Present Continuous - Conditionals Type 1 - When/If

pairsWith.noteUz: 1-5-unitlar takrori (Revision): xatolar, savol-javob moslash, 20 ta test.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 5-UNIT: REVISION 1-5 DAVOMI (29-bet, PDF 28). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '5'.

CHAP USTUN:
13-mashq davomi: 9 What will she does if she fails her final exams? 10 Tess aren't going to take driving lessons. 11 I think the weather will to get colder soon. 12 Jane isn't watering the plants yesterday afternoon. 13 I'm look forward to seeing you soon. 14 What was you doing at 10 o'clock last night? 15 She doesn't want to go out because it raining.
14) 'Match the questions to the answers.' 1 What is Chris doing right now? 2 How much are these trainers? 3 Is Harrods in Paris? 4 Do they always have bacon and eggs for breakfast? 5 Did Jack use to have a pet? 6 Are the Smiths buying a new car? 7 Has Sarah got blonde hair? 8 Was Jane asleep when the phone rang? Javoblar: a Yes, she has. b No, she wasn't. c No, he didn't. d Yes, they are. e They're £70. f No, they don't. g He's studying Maths. h No, it isn't.
15) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 Melanie is taller ...... Susan. A of B than C from. 2 Tom ...... work for this company anymore. A doesn't B isn't C don't. 3 Janet ...... to Scotland on Tuesday. A is flying B flies C are flying. 4 Sam often ...... a ride to the seaside. A is taking B take C takes. 5 A: Terry loves reading poetry. B: ...... does Nancy. A Neither B Nor C So.

O'NG USTUN:
6 ...... Mary use to live in Ireland? A Does B Did C Is. 7 Charlie is ...... than Alex. A short B shorter C shortest. 8 Is Los Angeles one of the ...... polluted cities in the world? A more B much C most. 9 I expect they ...... us around 9 o'clock. A will call B are calling C are going to call. 10 That ...... be Susie eating in the Mexican restaurant. She hates spicy food. A must B can't C can. 11 Carla was washing the car ...... Tim was cutting the grass. A while B before C until. 12 ...... you going to the cinema on Saturday night? A Will B Are C Do. 13 A: I can't do this exercise. B: Don't worry, I ...... you. A help B helping C will help. 14 If you don't wear your boots, your feet ...... wet. A got B will get C getting. 15 I'll help you clean the house ...... I get home. A if B as C when. 16 A: Bill is younger than Harry. B: No, he isn't. He's ...... . A old B oldest C older. 17 He ...... and fell as he was crossing the street. A slipping B slips C slipped. 18 Liza used to ...... quite plump when she was 8 years old. A be B been C was. 19 She doesn't ...... much free time. A has B have C having. 20 The red sweatshirt is not as ...... as the blue one. A nice B nicest C nicer.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '29'.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example (continued).
exercises.explanationUz:
XATOLAR - DAVOMI.

  9 does → DO (will + asosiy)
  10 aren't → ISN'T (Tess)
  11 will to get → WILL GET
  12 isn't watering → WASN'T
     watering (yesterday)
  13 I'm look → I'M LOOKING /
     I look
  14 was you → WERE you
  15 it raining → it IS raining
     (it's raining)


⚠ 'TO FAIL EXAMS':

  = imtihondan yiqilmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the questions to the answers.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL → JAVOB: yordamchi fe'lga
  qarang.

  1 What is Chris doing? → g He's
    studying Maths.
  2 How much are ...? → e They're
    £70.
  3 Is Harrods in Paris? → h No, it
    isn't.
  4 Do they always ...? → f No,
    they don't.
  5 Did Jack use to ...? → c No, he
    didn't.
  6 Are the Smiths buying ...? → d
    Yes, they are.
  7 Has Sarah got ...? → a Yes, she
    has.
  8 Was Jane asleep ...? → b No,
    she wasn't.


⚠ 'HARRODS':

  = Londondagi mashhur univermag.


⚠ 'TRAINERS':

  = krossovkalar.

items.textEn: Melanie is taller ___ Susan.
items.uz: Melani Syuzandan balandroq.

items.textEn: Tom ___ work for this company anymore.
items.uz: Tom endi bu kompaniyada ishlamaydi.

items.textEn: Janet ___ to Scotland on Tuesday.
items.uz: Janet seshanba kuni Shotlandiyaga uchadi.

items.textEn: Sam often ___ a ride to the seaside.
items.uz: Sem tez-tez dengiz bo'yiga sayr qiladi.

items.textEn: A: Terry loves reading poetry. B: ___ does Nancy.
items.uz: A: Terri she'r o'qishni yaxshi ko'radi. B: Nensi ham.

items.textEn: ___ Mary use to live in Ireland?
items.uz: Meri ilgari Irlandiyada yasharmidi?

items.textEn: Charlie is ___ than Alex.
items.uz: Charli Aleksdan past bo'yli.

items.textEn: Is Los Angeles one of the ___ polluted cities in the world?
items.uz: Los-Anjeles dunyodagi eng ifloslangan shaharlardan birimi?

items.textEn: I expect they ___ us around 9 o'clock.
items.uz: Menimcha, ular bizga soat 9 larda qo'ng'iroq qilishadi.

items.textEn: That ___ be Susie eating in the Mexican restaurant. She hates spicy food.
items.uz: Meksika restoranida ovqatlanayotgan Syuzi bo'lishi mumkin emas. U achchiq taomni yomon ko'radi.

items.textEn: Carla was washing the car ___ Tim was cutting the grass.
items.uz: Karla mashina yuvayotganda Tim maysa o'rayotgan edi.

items.textEn: ___ you going to the cinema on Saturday night?
items.uz: Shanba kechasi kinoga borasanmi?

items.textEn: A: I can't do this exercise. B: Don't worry, I ___ you.
items.uz: A: Bu mashqni qila olmayapman. B: Xavotir olma, yordam beraman.

items.textEn: If you don't wear your boots, your feet ___ wet.
items.uz: Etigingni kiymasang, oyog'ing ho'l bo'ladi.

items.textEn: I'll help you clean the house ___ I get home.
items.uz: Uyga kelganimda uyni tozalashga yordam beraman.

items.textEn: A: Bill is younger than Harry. B: No, he isn't. He's ___.
items.uz: A: Bill Harridan kichik. B: Yo'q. U kattaroq.

items.textEn: He ___ and fell as he was crossing the street.
items.uz: Ko'chani kesib o'tayotganda u sirpanib yiqildi.

items.textEn: Liza used to ___ quite plump when she was 8 years old.
items.uz: Liza 8 yoshida ancha to'la edi.

items.textEn: She doesn't ___ much free time.
items.uz: Uning bo'sh vaqti ko'p emas.

items.textEn: The red sweatshirt is not as ___ as the blue one.
items.uz: Qizil sviter ko'kidek chiroyli emas.

patterns.formula: Is / Do / Did / Has / Was + KIM ...? — Yes, ... is / do / did / has / was.
patterns.exampleEn: Has Sarah got blonde hair? — Yes, she has. Did Jack use to have a pet? — No, he didn't.
patterns.exampleUz: Saraning sochi sariqmi? — Ha. Jekning ilgari uy hayvoni bormidi? — Yo'q.

patterns.formula: X is not as + SIFAT + as Y
patterns.exampleEn: The red sweatshirt is not as nice as the blue one.
I expect they will call us around 9 o'clock.
patterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, ular bizga 9 larda qo'ng'iroq qilishadi.
